header.toggleTheme: Switch between the light and dark theme

checklist.title: Before you start
checklist.intro: Bug Detective runs SupportDesk in Docker and opens it in your own VS Code. Let's check that everything is installed.

docker.title: Docker Desktop
docker.notInstalled: Docker Desktop is not installed. Install it with the WSL 2 backend, then come back.
docker.notRunning: Docker Desktop is installed but not running.
docker.starting: Docker Desktop is starting. This can take a minute.

wsl.title: WSL 2
wsl.notFound: WSL is not installed. Open PowerShell as administrator and run: wsl --install
wsl.wsl1Only: Only WSL 1 was found. Docker Desktop needs WSL 2: run wsl --set-default-version 2

vscode.title: Visual Studio Code
vscode.cliNotFound: VS Code was not found. Install it (the default options are fine), then check again.

devcontainers.title: Dev Containers extension
devcontainers.ok: The Dev Containers extension is installed.
devcontainers.extensionMissing: VS Code needs the Dev Containers extension to open the code inside the container.
devcontainers.checkFailed: Could not list the VS Code extensions. Try again.

banner.dockerStopped: Docker is not running. Actions that need it are paused until it is back.

environment.title: Downloads needed
environment.intro: Some parts of the game environment are not on this computer yet. Connect to the internet, then install them. After that, the game works offline.

items.qaImage: QA image (Node.js 26, Playwright Chromium), about 3 GB

environment.installing: Installing… This can take several minutes.

dashboard.previousDirective: You are viewing the directive for a previous ticket ({{key}}, done). Your active assignment is {{active}}.
dashboard.previousDirectiveNoActive: You are viewing the directive for a ticket you already finished ({{key}}).
dashboard.nextTitle: Next action: get your next assignment
dashboard.nextBody: The ticket is downloaded and your workspace is set up for it. One ticket at a time.
dashboard.unlocking: Downloading and setting up the ticket…
dashboard.unlockingBody: Unpacking the stage and preparing your workspace container.
dashboard.finishFirst: Finish the current ticket to get the next one.
dashboard.blockedDockerBody: Start Docker Desktop to download your next ticket. Your previous fixes are safe.
dashboard.dockerDownActive: Docker is not running. VS Code and the app open again once it is back.
dashboard.completedBody: You already finished this ticket: it passed QA and the code review was accepted.
dashboard.allDoneBody: Your board and your code are still here to explore.
dashboard.queuedBody: Your next ticket is ready to download.

board.title: Board
board.hint: Drag your card from To Do to In Progress, then to In QA when it is fixed. The other moves happen on their own.
board.notAllowed: Only QA and the code review move a card there.
board.empty: No tickets yet. Get your first assignment on the Dashboard.

ticket.devServerDown: The app is not running. Run npm run dev in the VS Code terminal, or start it here.
ticket.readOnly: This ticket is done. It is read-only.

senior.intro: {{name}} is happy to help. Hints come one at a time, from general to specific.
senior.question: Hi {{name}}, I'm stuck on this one. Could you point me in the right direction?
senior.solutionQuestion: I tried the hints and I'm still stuck. Could you walk me through the fix?
senior.solutionIntro: Here is how the reference fix works. You still need to apply it in your workspace and pass QA.
senior.onlyInProgress: Move the card to In Progress to ask for help.
senior.noMoreHints: No more hints. You can ask for the full solution.

ticket.vscodeHint: VS Code opens attached to the workspace container. If a VS Code window for this workspace is already open but disconnected (after an update or a restore), close it or run "Developer: Reload Window" in it.

comment.gate1Failed: Gate 1 failed: existing functionality broke. Your change made project tests fail. Fix them before resubmitting.
comment.gate2Failed: Gate 2 failed: the reported bug is still unresolved. The app still shows the behavior described in the ticket.
comment.timeout: Timeout: QA exceeded the time limit of {{seconds}} seconds, possibly because of a hang or infinite loop.
comment.interrupted: QA was interrupted because the app closed. This does not count as an attempt. Move the card to In QA again.
comment.error: QA could not run. This does not count as an attempt. Details: {{detail}}
comment.branchWarning: Heads-up: your workspace is not on this ticket's code (it was switched in Git). QA evaluates the current files anyway.

qa.running: QA is running for this ticket. It cannot be cancelled.

review.title: Code review
review.noDiff: No changes were found against the stage.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your preferences, check your developer tools and keep your progress safe.
settings.languageHelp: Changes the app and the directives you receive from management.
settings.themeHelp: Pick a look, or follow your operating system.
settings.qaTimeoutHelp: How long an automated QA run may take before it stops.
settings.environmentHelp: The tools Bug Detective needs to run SupportDesk in a dev container.
settings.diskHelp: Space the game's Docker images and volumes take on this computer.

qaCache.name: QA dependency cache
qaCache.help: npm packages for offline QA runs

settings.diskNeedsDocker: Start Docker to measure disk usage.
settings.backupHelp: Your work lives in a Docker volume. A Docker reset deletes it, so export a save file from time to time.
settings.needsDocker: Start Docker to export or restore your progress.

locked.title: Actions locked: {{task}}
locked.body: Export, restore and new game are paused until it finishes.

settings.dangerZoneHelp: Start over from the first ticket. The board, history and hints are reset; the code in your workspace is archived, not deleted.
settings.newGameWarning: Your board, completed tickets and current assignment will be reset, and you start again from the first ticket. Export your progress first if you want to keep a copy. Code in the workspace is archived, not deleted.
settings.restoreWarning: This replaces your current progress and the workspace Docker volume. Uncommitted and unexported work will be lost.
settings.restoringHelp: Rebuilding the workspace volume and repository. Do not close Bug Detective.
settings.aboutTagline: An offline desktop game for developers who want to practice debugging real code.

errors.dockerUnavailable: Docker is not running. Start Docker Desktop and try again.
errors.environmentNotReady: Install the missing downloads on the Dashboard first.
errors.busy: Please wait for the current task to finish.
errors.hintsRemaining: Ask for the remaining hints first.
